profile.headline: VP & Lead Software Engineer | Pega Technical Lead | Payments & Fintech Platforms | OpenShift / Kubernetes Modernization | AI-Assisted Delivery
profile.summary:
I'm a VP-level Lead Software Engineer and fintech platform leader with 15+ years of experience delivering enterprise payments infrastructure, cloud modernization, and distributed systems.
 
Payments & Fintech Engineering I specialize in real-time payments and financial messaging workflows — Real Time Payments (The Clearing House), Fed Now (Federal Reserve), SWIFT, Fedwire, CHIPS, and ISO 20022 (Pacs, Camt, Admi, Remit). I've led end-to-end development of wires, FX, and payment investigation platforms, maintaining 99.9%+ production uptime with zero critical incidents across multiple release cycles.
 
Cloud Modernization & DevOps - I've driven full-stack cloud migration from legacy WebLogic VMs to Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes, and modernized CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins and IBM Urban Code Deploy to GitHub Actions and Harness. Experienced with Oracle 19c, Kafka, REST APIs, MQ integrations, and Liquibase database migration.
 
Engineering Leadership -  I led distributed US/India engineering and QA teams across the full SDLC — driving Agile and Scrum delivery, Selenium test automation, stakeholder advisory, and executive communication. I translate complex platform decisions into clear business strategy for compliance, business owners, and C-suite audiences.
 
AI & Emerging Technology Early adopter of agentic AI development — independently built and launched two SaaS products (ChlorophyllAI.com, KeyFolioHQ.com) using Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Introduced GenAI tooling into enterprise delivery pipelines and identified AI/ML use cases for payments classification and automated case routing.
 
Core Technologies: Pega Systems PegaRULES PRPC · RTP · Fed Now · SWIFT · ISO 20022 · OpenShift · Kubernetes · GitHub Actions · Harness · Jenkins · Oracle 19c · Kafka · REST APIs · Java · Agile · Scrum · CI/CD · Pega CSSA · Azure AZ-900 Certified
 
VP Engineering · Principal Engineer · Fintech · Payments · Cloud Migration and Management
